concerns.text: T101 (consumer) instructs loading `code/contracts/raw_halo.schema.yaml`, but no task produces that file and no contract by that name exists — plan.md and data-model.md list only `halo.schema.yaml` and `results.schema.yaml`. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency on a nonexistent artifact; either a producer task must create it or T101 must reference `code/contracts/halo.schema.yaml`.

The re-plan note says 'Previously verified tasks are preserved as checked', yet every task in the 'Verified work' list (T003–T030) is an unchecked `- [ ]` box while only T031–T037 show `[X]`. The completion state of the upstream producers (T012–T025) that T101/T102/T103 depend on is ambiguous, making the effective dependency chain unverifiable to an implementer.

T103 is tagged [US1] but implements FR-003, which spec.md anchors to US-3 ('See US-3'). This mislabeling breaks the user-story grouping rule that each US block form an independently shippable unit — the overdensity producer for US-3's environment binning sits in the US-1 block.
